entries.1abcf1964a1ceb59: Collabos Corporation is a company headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 70.
entries.1fc0efb5c073c2ab: Under its corporate philosophy, 'Enthusiastic amateurs surpass experts – start new things yourself –', it aims to realize 'OnetoOne customer support', centered on call centers and connecting points of contact between companies and customers through cloud services. Its future strategy has two points: to channel sales and development resources into proprietary services such as "VLOOM" and "UZ", shifting its earnings base from existing services to proprietary services; and to steadily maintain and grow revenue through DX proposals and retention activities with "@nyplace" customers.
entries.25863dd9574bedec: This is a customer information management system specialized for inbound call center operations that receive telephone calls. It can manage calls, emails and Web inquiries in one place. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥86 million.
entries.279c4fd66f1660f6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,699 million, down 10.9% year on year.

entries.2c61533f47b6e9f8: Add-on services such as the integrated CRM marketing system “GROWCE,” the AI marketing system “UZ,” the data mining tool “GOLDEN LIST,” the real-time speech recognition system “AmiVoice Communication Suite provided by Collabos Corporation,” the call recording system “Packet Folder,” the overflow call prevention service “Afullect,” and the FAQ system “CollasQ.” Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥157 million.
entries.436812debcff3b3a: A customer information management system specialized in outbound call center operations such as telesales. It includes functions such as creating call target lists and call result reports. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36 million.
